name: Do I need to do anything before a water softener installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything before a water softener installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your water softener installation, it's helpful to clear the area around your main water line and the intended installation spot to allow our technicians easy access. Additionally, having an idea of your household's daily water usage can help us recommend the appropriately sized system for optimal efficiency and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the installation area and have an idea of your household's water usage to help determine the right system size.
